Abundance & Ecology

Map reads back to viral references to estimate genome abundance and population dynamics.

Stage 9 of the Viral Metagenome Workflow. Click Abundance & Ecology for the walkthrough, or a neighboring stage to browse its tools.

By mapping raw reads back to a set of reference viral genomes, these tools calculate coverage depth and breadth across samples, enabling comparisons of viral community structure, population dynamics, and ecological patterns across environments or time points.
Tool Description Platforms Links Reference
Read2RefMapper Maps short reads to a reference set of viral genomes to estimate relative genome abundance across samples. CyVerse KBase Docs coming soon · Official Bolduc et al., ISME J (2017)
BowtieBatch Batch wrapper around Bowtie2 for mapping multiple read datasets to a shared viral reference in parallel. CyVerse KBase Docs coming soon · Official Bolduc et al., ISME J (2017)
CoverM A configurable, easy to use and fast DNA read coverage and relative abundance calculator focused on metagenomics, reporting coverage per genome/MAG or per contig from sorted BAM files or raw reads. HPC Docs coming soon · Official Aroney et al., Bioinformatics (2025)
Bowtie2 An ultrafast and memory-efficient tool for aligning sequencing reads to long reference sequences; supports gapped, local and paired-end alignment. HPC Docs coming soon · Official Langmead & Salzberg, Nature Methods (2012)
